findings.finding: The first Droid evidence filter allowed a missing num_turns value through jq type ordering and checked only outer evidence arrays, not their item schemas.
findings.resolution: Required numeric, non-negative, bounded num_turns and exact inner command/test object keys, result enums, and string-only list items; extended negative mutations and reran focused tests.

findings.finding: The first validator proved the activation gate existed but did not prove it preceded the Droid invocation, and inspected the wrong continue-on-error property spelling for parsed YAML.
findings.resolution: Required gate index to precede run_droid, rejected the parsed continue-on-error key, rejected in-script gate reassignment, and added reorder/continue-on-error mutation tests.
